sourceText: After reconciling the earlier duplicate M3 onto main, keep only the genuinely net-new value: close the control-arm memory JSON-leak surfaces that main B-ab8d left host-readable (it keeps the pack in JSON for lossless measurement), gate final_response_check (the 8th RuntimeConsumer), gate parallel_dispatch experience injection, and add two corpus tools to the retrieval block.
normalizedOutcome: On the control arm (LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=control), every JSON/file runtime-memory-pack surface is empty (done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff/manifest/health), final_response_check text is suppressed, parallel_dispatch injects no experienceRefs, and memory_benchmark_real_data/source_lineage_audit are refused; treatment and no-experiment output is byte-identical.
acceptanceClaim: Running the CLI under LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=control returns empty runtime-memory packs (empty results/items, nulled sourceDigests, empty-set packDigest) at every serialized surface while treatment/no-experiment return populated packs, proven by the experience-arm-gate + experience-arm-isolation-e2e smokes.
